title: Localization-dependent activation of the DEAD-box ATPase Vasa by eLOTUS domains
authors: Garbelyanski A; Hauser D; Trolese A; Kumar P; Gan HH; de Almeida C; Meyer MP; Hondele M; Carlomagno T; Gunsalus KC; Jeske M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DEAD-box RNA解旋酶Vasa的定位依赖性激活机制，核心是RNA-蛋白互作，不涉及DNA或转录因子，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

DEAD-box RNA helicases remodel RNA structures in many cellular pathways, yet how their activity is spatially controlled in cells remains poorly understood. The Drosophila germline helicase Vasa functions in ovaries only when localized to cytoplasmic granules, a process mediated by eLOTUS-domain proteins. Here, we define the mechanism by which eLOTUS domains activate Vasa. Biochemical analyses reveal that Vasa alone is largely inactive. eLOTUS domains bind the open conformation of Vasa and promote formation of the closed RNA- and ATP-bound state by accelerating RNA engagement. This stimulation requires a positively charged intrinsically disordered sequence within eLOTUS that increases RNA association. Mutations in this element abolish Vasa stimulation while preserving binding. We demonstrate that Vasa activation is essential in vivo . Together, these findings reveal a localization-dependent mechanism for regulating the DEAD-box helicase Vasa, in which enzymatic activity is gated by a spatially restricted cofactor.
abstract_zh:
摘要

DEAD-box RNA解旋酶在许多细胞通路中重塑RNA结构，然而其活性在细胞中如何被空间调控仍知之甚少。果蝇生殖系解旋酶Vasa仅在定位于细胞质颗粒时才在卵巢中发挥功能，这一过程由eLOTUS结构域蛋白介导。在此，我们定义了eLOTUS结构域激活Vasa的机制。生化分析揭示，单独的Vasa基本无活性。eLOTUS结构域结合Vasa的开放构象，并通过加速RNA结合促进闭合的RNA和ATP结合状态的形成。这种刺激作用需要eLOTUS内一段带正电荷的内在无序序列，该序列增加RNA关联。此元件中的突变废除Vasa刺激作用，同时保留结合能力。我们证明Vasa激活在体内至关重要。综合这些发现，揭示了一种调控DEAD-box解旋酶Vasa的定位依赖性机制，其中酶活性由空间限制的辅因子门控。
